items.title: Amgen earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Amgen Inc (AMGN) reported Q3 on Nov 3, 2026, and the numbers were strong. Adjusted EPS was $6.45 against a $5.76 estimate (+11.98%), and revenue was $10.40B against $10.06B. The stock is $478.5 (+3.74%) as of Nov 4, 12:25 PM EST, near its 52-week high of $482.0. It is up about 61% over one year. The after-hours dip on Nov 3 faded once the session opened.
